articles.title: Bitcoin sell pressure ‘closer to exhaustion’ after $4B USDT market-cap drop: CryptoQuant
articles.snippet: Bitcoin analysis suggested that sell pressure would not increase given the historically large contraction in USDT market cap over a 60-day period.

articles.title: Vitalik Buterin Says Ethereum Is Betting Its Future on Quantum Security and AI
